note: Major dialogue facts for Journal / 여행 기록. Match key: place + npc (TLK English name) + topic (TOPIC stem or job/heal). A chain is local to one place; a destination starts a new chain while goal/complete_if_recorded completes the source tip. goal empty = complete on record (including learned mantras); rune:<virtue>|stone:<color> = pending until action. Ask-tips may use complete_on_goal mantra:<virtue> as a shrine fallback. know virtue:<name>|mantra:<name> fills the journal collection page. Talk-chain goals: ask:* completed by Journal.mark_id or mark_goal when the follow-up talk happens. Same id with upgrade:true expands an existing clue (en_upgraded/ko_upgraded on the base catalog row). Action tips use Ask / Search / Meet (묻기 / 찾기 / 만나기); knowledge facts keep Topic: detail. Official place names use {paws}-style tokens resolved by Locale.fill_places from place_* keys.
